title: Archiving Section, defined in include/archiving.toml
description: Archiving settings for ATOS to ECFS. Locations, and time intervals to archive for each file type

prefix.title: Path prefixes
prefix.description: Prefix to prepend paths. Like 'ec:/user/ for ecfs on atos or 'user@host:' for scp

archive_type.description: Prefix to use for available archive types. Define one per type where applicable.

example.title: Example settings for the archiving rules. Any number of rules can be defined to accomodate the needs

active.description: Activates the default archiving. Could be boolean or string refering to a boolean in the config file. See the sqlite archiving for an example

inpath.description: Location of input files for archiving

outpath.description: Relative location of the archived files

pattern.description: Search pattern for files to be included. Could be a single pattern or list of patterns.

newname.description: Target name for renaming of files. Only works is pattern is a string and matches an existing file

tarname.description: Tar file name in case of compress method.

copy.title: Copy settings for the per cycle archiving
